claim.excerpt: Among the 10,996 drivers with at least one positive test, the median blood concentrations of ethanol, THC, MDMA, amphetamine, benzoylecgonine, and 6-MAM were respectively 1.82 g/L, 2.41 ng/mL, 138.4 ng/mL, 67.7 ng/mL, 173.3 ng/mL, and 0.97 ng/mL.

sources.title: Alcohol and drug consumption among motor vehicle drivers in the Brittany region of France: A 9-year cross-sectional population study

why_it_matters: Concentration values are often misread as thresholds; the reviewer must confirm specimen, population, statistic and that the value is reported in context only.
limitations: Median across all positive drivers; not limited to cocaine-only cases.

concentration_context.population: motor vehicle drivers in Brittany, France, with at least one positive test
limitations: Median across all positive drivers; not limited to cocaine-only cases.
